answer.verdict: Per-frame fight camera is FUN_00182430: FUN_00182b08 then FUN_0018e1e0 writes eye=base+dir*1000, then FUN_00193800 builds a look-at whose eye XZ stays at ELF 0. VU1 is handed the 4x4 at 0x01CE2270+(*(cam+0x174))*0xC0. VCALLMS clippers are off this path. No COP1/VU0 op on the path was shown to drop that 1000. A side-view PCSX2 eye is off the fighters; an eye at the origin matches our shot. Compare the six slots in fix[].

facts.c: GP=0x0035F270 from entry lui a0,0x36 / addiu a0,-0xD90 / daddu gp,a0.
Our shot_90s: Kazuya arm/shoulder fills the frame, beach stage (palms, building) still a wide view, HUD STAGE 1 00:02:65 timer 57 KAZUYA vs LAW.
PCSX2 pcsx2_68s: both fighters full-body side view, STAGE 1 00:01:30 timer 58 KAZUYA vs STEVE.
Status: camera far too close; same fight after the stall fix reaches 00:11:85 timer 48. Interpreter-vs-native for this camera is the task FACT, not re-run here.
Fight update FUN_00182430 stores cam=*(fighter+0xF08) at sp+0 and fighter+0x660 at sp+0xC, calls FUN_00182b08(fighter), then FUN_00193800(a0=cam, a1=fighter+0x660).
FUN_00182b08: s2=*(fighter+0xF08), s4=fighter+0x660, calls FUN_0018e1e0(a0=*(s2+0x198), a1=s2, a2=*(s2+0x180), a3=fighter+0x660). Also calls FUN_002440a8, not FUN_00244fc8.
FUN_0018e1e0 early-outs if a2==0. s1=a0 so the *1000 direction object is *(cam+0x198). It loads float gp-0x7120 and vmulx.xyz's the vec at a3 (fighter+0x660).
gp-0x7120=0x358150 holds 0.2f (0x3e4ccccd) in the ELF.
At 0x18e56c the 1000.0f (lui at,0x447A) is qmtc2'd and vmaddx.xyzw vf16,vf31,vf1x stores base+dir*1000 to heap+0xC0. dir is lqc2 from s2+0, base from s2+0x30, and s2 was set equal to a0.

SET_GPR_U32 writes only the low 64 bits (sign-extended int32) and keeps the GPR high 64. vmaddx/vmulx broadcast lane X, which is that low 32. The 1000.0f and the 0.2f therefore hit the lane the multiply uses.
Other 1000.0f immediates in the same function: 0x18e6c4, 0x18eb30, 0x18fc78. Bodies not read.
FUN_0018e1e0 calls atan2f at 0x18ea0c, 0x18ea1c, 0x18faec, 0x18fafc and FUN_0018d9e0 at 0x18ea2c and 0x18fb0c. FUN_0018d9e0 calls FUN_0018d968 three times.
FUN_0018d968 vsqrt Q,vf5w is emitted as sqrtf(max(0, vf5.w)); cfc2 copies Q's bits and qmtc2 puts them in vf5; the next op is vaddx/vsubx of vf5x. Lane matches.

FUN_00193800 is the only lui 0x2D + addiu 0x27D0/0x27E0/0x27F0. It swc1's one float to +4 of each vec (0x2D27D4, 0x2D27E4, 0x2D27F4), which is Y, then builds the basis with two vrsqrt Q,vf0w,vf31w. A full-file scan found no stored pointer dword 0x2D27D0/E0/F0.

vrsqrt impl: Q=(w>0)?1/sqrt(w):0. The preceding dot uses vmulax.w of vf0, whose w is 1, so a nonzero delta does not force Q to 0. vwaitq is a no-op because Q is written immediately, and vmulq is after vwaitq.
FUN_00193800 writes the stack matrix pointer to *((*(cam+0x1BC))+0x1C)+0x34 and calls FUN_0018fd30 on that object. FUN_0018fd30 sets t4=a0 and lqc2's the 4x4 at *(t4+0x34).
Because all three Y slots get the same float and X/Z have no store, C-A stays (1000,0,0) and B-A stays (0,0,1000), and the eye XZ stays 0. That is true on PCSX2 too unless a writer was missed.
FUN_00244e88 inits the slot at 0x01CE2270+(*(obj+0x174))*0xC0 to identity (1 at +0,+0x14,+0x28, vf0 at +0x30) and writes 1.0f to slot+0x74. It calls FUN_0020a0b8(slot).

FUN_00244fc8 reads that same slot (s4=0x01CE2270+(*(a0+0x174))*0xC0, delay-slot addu before jal func_2167A0) and copies the 4x4 plus the float at +0x74 and the floats at gp-0x571C/gp-0x5718 into a CNT qwc=0x17 / MSCAL 0x1400002B / UNPACK 0x6C15000B packet. Those two gp floats are 0.0 in the ELF at 0x359B54 and 0x359B58. lwc1 -0x571C(gp) / -0x5718(gp) are at 0x245574/0x245578.

Direct jals: FUN_00244fc8 only from FUN_001969f8:833, and FUN_001969f8 only from entry:180. FUN_001969f8 indexes players 0..1 at 0x2AA0D0 and passes *(ent+0xF08). Those two words are 0 in the ELF. FUN_001808e8 builds the same packet from its a1; callers FUN_001820e8:62 and FUN_00181e08:253.

File words at 0x2A92BC, 0x2C76B4, 0x2D5858, 0x2D588C, 0x2DC5EC hold FUN_001969f8/1808e8/244e88/244fc8/18d528 and the next word is the function size (0x4FC, 0x608, 0x140, 0x6F4, 0x440). Descriptors, not shown as call targets.

VCALLMS exists only in FUN_0018d528 (0x0 at 0x18d5a0 and 0x98 at 0x18d7ec) and FUN_0025a0d8 (0x78). No jal func_18D528. FUN_0025a0d8 is only called from FUN_00259c20, which is only called from FUN_0018d528. executeVU0Microprogram does m_vu0.reset() then copy in, execute, copy out.
No jal to sceVu0CameraMatrix (0x2935D8) or sceVu0ViewScreenMatrix (0x2937B0) in generated/.
0x01CE2270 is not in any PT_LOAD filesz (BSS). The second LOAD covers vaddr 0x180080 filesz 0x1d9de8, which ends before 0x1CE2270.

fix.change: Read u32 0x2AA0D0 and 0x2AA0D4 (ELF 0; live fighter ptrs). For each non-null p, cam=u32[p+0xF08], idx=u32[cam+0x174], dirp=u32[cam+0x198]. Slot=0x01CE2270+idx*0xC0.

ELF is A(0,0,0,1) B(0,0,1000,1) C(1000,0,0,1). Code writes only Y (+4) of all three with one float, so X/Z should stay 0,0,1000 / 1000,0 on BOTH if no missed writer. PCSX2 X or Z of A nonzero => missed writer, and that is the eye. Both still origin => this look-at is not the diverging value.

fix.where: slot+0x00 for 0x40 bytes, and f32 slot+0x74
fix.change: This is the 4x4 FUN_00244fc8 uploads (translation at +0x30). Init is identity and +0x74=1.0. PCSX2 fight, if this is the view: not identity; translation xyz off the fighters (both bodies in frame). Ours matching the shot: translation ~0 or eye on one fighter. +0x74 stays 1.0 unless a later store; do not treat 1.0 as FOV until the two sides differ.

Inputs of the *1000 at FUN_0018e1e0 0x18e598. |dir|~1 => placed eye ~1000 from the base. |dir|~0 => eye stays on the base (inside the fighter). Compare |dir| and base xyz. The placed result is heap+0xC0 inside that call, not a fixed address; log it in our runtime at the sqc2, and on PCSX2 prefer dir and base.
ELF 0.2f (0x3e4ccccd), the vmulx scale on fighter+0x660. Expect 0.2 on both unless a runtime store. If both are 0.2 the close-up is not this constant.
ELF 0. Copied into the same VU packet as the matrix (FUN_00244fc8 0x245574/0x245578). If both stay 0 they are not the zoom. If PCSX2 is nonzero and ours is 0, log them next.

contra: The 1000s at 0x2D27E8 and 0x2D27F0 are look-at target offsets. vrsqrt normalizes them away. They are not the camera distance. The distance constant is the separate 1000.0f vmaddx in FUN_0018e1e0.
swc1 to 0x2D27D4/0x2D27E4/0x2D27F4 writes Y (+4), not W (+0xC). W stays the ELF 1.0.
FUN_0018d528 and FUN_0025a0d8 are the clip path (vcallms 0/0x98/0x78). No jal from the camera functions. Their micro bodies were not disassembled.
qmtc2 of 1000.0f and of the FUN_0018d968 sqrt does not drop the value: the following op broadcasts lane X, and X holds the float. The stale GPR high 64 is not read.
No jal to sceVu0CameraMatrix or sceVu0ViewScreenMatrix. The fight camera is the game's own VU0-macro math.
The file has no pointer dword to 0x2D27D0 or 0x01CE2270. Words that contain FUN_00244fc8 etc. are followed by the function size, so they are descriptors, not proof of a per-frame indirect call.
FUN_00244fc8's only direct jal is entry->FUN_001969f8, and 0x2AA0D0 is 0 in the ELF, so that upload can miss a live camera. Do not assume the slot changes every frame until PINE shows it.

A uniform model-scale bug is still open. 0x358150 is 0.2 on the fighter vec, but the shot (one fighter filling the frame, the other a sliver, stage wide) fits an eye next to one fighter. It does not by itself prove the scale path is innocent if the scale is per character.
User FACT: GOW_VU1_NATIVE_OFF=1 shows the same close camera. Not re-run this session. Native VU1 is not required for the bug.
